items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 502

TO THE ASSEMBLY:

I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills:

Assembly Bill Number 7706, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to amend the soil and water conservation districts law, in
      relation to establishing a drain tile revolving loan program"

Assembly Bill Number 9288-A, entitled:

    "AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to the
      beginning farmer revolving loan fund program"

    NOT APPROVED

  Each of these bills would create a new revolving loan program  without
appropriation  to  be  administered by the Department of Agriculture and
Markets (DAM) and the New York State Soil & Water Conservation Committee
(SWCC). One program would provide low  interest  loans  to  farmers  for
enhancing their farm fields with drain tile, and the other would support
beginning farmers.

  I  share the sponsors' concern for providing critical support to farm-
ers, and I have implemented several initiatives to provide financial and
other assistance to grow existing farms and support  new  farms  in  New
York.  The  2014-15 Budget funded the New York Beginning Farmers Fund to
provide grants to beginning farmers, including access to funds for  tile
drainage, and for student loan forgiveness for agriculture college grad-
uates  who  commit to farm in New York. In addition, DAM has initiated a
Beginning Farmer Working Group consisting of farmers,  private  lenders,
and other stakeholders to examine issues important to new farmers and to
assess  the  demand  for  additional  technical and financial assistance
beyond the State and federal assistance already available  to  beginning
farmers.

  Although  the  intent  of these bills is laudable, the Division of the
Budget estimates it would cost the  State  several  million  dollars  to
capitalize each revolving loan fund and several hundred thousand dollars
annually  to  administer each loan program. Because of the fiscal impli-
cations, these  bills  should  be  considered  in  budget  negotiations.
Therefore, I will not approve either of these bills.

  These bills are disapproved.                (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
                              __________
